notes: Random big-endian scene headers with format bits 0..1 clear (the fatal exit [0x132a74] does not return; the original leaves its argument pushed and pops it into EDI), the name at +0x30 empty, partly or fully set, and the end marker after 0 to 75 command words (never at the header words +0x10/+0x20, which are swapped twice). The record normalizer 0xc4e3b (logging ESI, its word, the converter hook and the scene at [EBP+8]), the name filler 0xe3cac and the fatal hook [0x132a74] (returning) are logging stubs.
